title: The C3 Power Stack
visual_prompt: A stylish isometric 3D infographic showing the C3 tools as translucent glass building blocks stacked vertically. The base block is 'c3_search' (Search), above it is 'c3_compress' (Map), followed by 'c3_read' (Extract), and capped with 'c3_memory' (Learn). Each block has a small, minimalist icon and a soft inner glow. The background is a sophisticated dark-grey gradient. High-end tech startup aesthetic.
typography_style: Modern Monospace for tool names, sleek Sans-Serif for descriptions.
layout_description: Vertical isometric stack with call-out lines explaining the 'Purpose' of each layer.
